title: NO CROWBAR SWING WHILE YOU ARE DROPPING IN
why: After a respawn in the demo you stand frozen for 3 seconds (DROPPING IN 3 2 1) inside your spawn shield. Shooting, throwing and rolling already wait for the drop-in, but the crowbar key V did not: it swung, took the spawn shield down and hit whatever stood next to you while you still could not move. Proven in the cloud: in the demo, after a respawn, a real V press during the count dropped the shield and took a crawler from 52 to 34 health. During the count V now does nothing, the same as the roll; the moment you drop in it swings as before.
now: The crowbar no longer swings while you are dropping in after a demo respawn, so it cannot take your spawn shield down.
